breakdown.description: Given COP exceeds the Carnot limit, which is physically impossible for a refrigerator between the stated temperatures.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth identifies that the given Coefficient of Performance (COP) of 20 is physically impossible because the maximum theoretical (Carnot) COP for the given temperatures is 5. The agent, however, did not recognize this physical impossibility and proceeded to use the flawed value of 20 in its calculation, directly contradicting the corrective action shown in the ground truth.
